about_the_game:
The Paths Between Worlds Lie Open!

A realm of heroes stretching across infinity, the Labyrinth connects fantastic worlds with hidden pathways and roads, visible to only a few. Between these paths, worlds rise and fall, heroes forge their destinies, and the all-consuming Void seeks a way in. 

The 
Labyrinth Worldbook  is a complete guide to the Labyrinth campaign overlay, allowing adventurers and game masters the freedom to travel to 
any  campaign setting. Within this tome, you'll find resources for the ultimate world-hopping adventure, including: 

<ul> <li> Over 10 new subclasses for the Tales of the Valiant Roleplaying Game, including battle-hardened Troopers, reality-bending Dreamer Druids, Waysmith Rangers, and more!  </li>
<li> The powers of the Void and the Labyrinth at your fingertips! Harness 5 new styles of magic, including Illumination, Dream, and the dread power of the Void. </li>
<li> A gazetteer to the known worlds and key locations of the Labyrinth, including over 50 worlds submitted by Kobold Press fans and supporters. </li>
<li> Dozens of unique factions, gods, items, and monsters to populate your next journey through the 10,000 Worlds. </li>
</ul> Leave your world behind. Step into countless realms of adventure! 

* Includes the content in the Players Guide, which is also offered as a separate module. 
"
